name: Raymond Weil Men's Millesime 39.5 Automatic Leather Strap Watch, Silver/Rose
desc: For this inaugural Millesime collection, RAYMOND WEIL pays homage to the rich heritage and traditions of horology while celebrating the simplicity of refined design. The salmon dial, located beneath a vintage-inspired sapphire crystal glass box, has been refined to the highest degree. A sapphire caseback affords sight of the self-winding movement within and the “W-shaped” oscillating weight, RAYMOND WEIL’s horological signature. Offered in a selection of dial colours, each model is paired with a colour-coordinating genuine calf leather strap with a unique W-stitched detail. As the name suggests, the collection is a grand vintage interpretation of the RAYMOND WEIL brand. Only once the product has been verified and authenticated will a return be authorised.

name: Skottsberg Stainless Steel Casserole & Lid, 20cm
desc: Skottsberg Stainless Steel cookware has an industrial look, is durable, energy-saving and with proper use stands for a lifetime of cooking pleasure. It offers a healthy alternative compared to cookware with synthetic non-stick coatings. Skottsberg Stainless Steel features a special tri-ply base made up of 18/10-grade stainless steel, aluminium and magnetic stainless steel. Stainless steel cookware is used because of its durability, ease of maintenance, and cleaning. The aluminium core, covered with stainless steel, ensures that you cook your ingredients evenly. The aluminium layer continues into the sides of the pan, so the pan heats up evenly and quickly to the top of the edge. The chance of sticking is greatly reduced, and the cookware is therefore very energy-efficient. Thanks to the magnetic stainless steel exterior, the cooking pot is suitable for induction and perfect for use on all other heating sources. The bottom of the pan has the perfect thickness, at 2.5 mm, to prevent it from warping on induction. Even heat distribution thanks to the tri-ply body Holds heat very well Can easily tolerate acids Suitable for the oven Easy to care for and dishwasher safe Safe to use on all hobs, including induction The pan may discolour slightly, but then you know you're using it properly Metal handles Metal pan handles heat up when cooking, so be careful when lifting pans and touching handles. Please use an oven glove, mitt or pot holder when handling hot pans.
attributeValue1: Dishwasher Safe, Hob Safe, Induction Compatible, Oven Safe
attributeValue8: After preparation, let the pan cool down. Make sure not to rinse the hot pan directly under or in cold water. This causes a thermal shock, which can cause the pan to warp. When the pan has cooled down, clean it with warm water and a washing-up brush or scratch-free scouring pad. You can also clean this pan in the dishwasher, but for a long life it is definitely recommended to wash the pan by hand. Make sure the pan is completely dry when you store it.
